title: Assemblée opens debate on a national register of garde à vue
content: The Assemblée des Républiques began on Thursday the examination of a proposed *loi* creating a national register of *gardes à vue*, in which every detention would be logged within the hour, with the identity of the officier de police judiciaire and the written grounds for any extension.

The text is directly inspired by last month’s *arrêt* of the Cour de Cassation limiting extensions in minor-offence cases. Its rapporteur argued that a central register would make “the written justification a fact rather than a formula”, while the ministère de l’Intérieur warned of a cost of some 30 million livres and of “a charge on the brigades de nuit”.

The commission des lois will hear the procureurs généraux and the barreaux next week; the government has not yet stated its position, and two groups have tabled *amendements* limiting the register to offences carrying more than three years.
author: Sophie Delorme, correspondante parlementaire — Presses de Vallonne
